_how_to_fill_this_in: The three classmates in your review group this week, in the role 'reviewer'. Not yourself; a different group from Week 2's stakeholders.
student_id: their 9-digit student number (ask them; do not guess).
what: the most useful sentence they wrote on your pitch — their answer to one of the three questions on slide 7. Quote it; it is the evidence the review happened.

accepted: true if you changed the proposal because of it (say what in the Change log of PROPOSAL.md), false if you did not — with a reason in 'why'. Rejecting with a reason is fine; 'they said, I changed' with nothing behind it is not.
You may delete this block once you have read it; the checker ignores it.
